summary: Bullish filed a Form 6-K (May 2026) reporting Q1 results and its definitive agreement to acquire Equiniti for $4.2 billion. Bullish is the acquirer. The transaction creates the first integrated blockchain-enabled, blue-chip issuer services provider, combining a regulated transfer agent with tokenization infrastructure. No board recommendation or advisor is named in this filing. The deal is subject to regulatory approvals and closing conditions; no premium or specific mechanics are detailed. Watch for regulatory clearance timelines and integration risk, as the deal expands Bullish's footprint from digital asset trading into traditional issuer services.
